metadata.description: Role-based Claude Code plugins that carry a product from design through development and QA to a production release.

plugins.name: design-kit
plugins.description: Designer workflows: UI/UX and accessibility review, design-system audit, and developer handoff specs. Connects the Figma MCP server.

plugins.name: dev-kit
plugins.description: Developer workflows: feature planning, pre-PR readiness check, and a code-review agent. Connects the GitHub MCP server.

plugins.name: qa-kit
plugins.description: QA workflows: test plans from a feature or PR, structured bug reports, and browser smoke tests. Connects the Playwright MCP server.

plugins.name: ship-checklist
plugins.description: The development-to-production gate: a staged readiness checklist, a go/no-go release-manager agent, and release notes.
